contract: Bounded styling and layout scopes. Preserve all feature, data, callback, telemetry, printer and file behavior. New search fields require their own adjacent anchored full regex builder. A shared palette does not complete a surface.

nextScopes.work: Audit registered shared controls for actual role resolution, field/button/card anatomy, density, measured labels, focus ring and state layers. Retain identifiers, input geometry and callbacks. Inventory callers that bypass shared controls before claiming coverage.
nextScopes.exclude: Do not rework Notebook routing, stable IDs, print actions or global tokens owned by the integrated palette unit.
nextScopes.acceptance: Control-specific before/after source review and focused checks, then real theme/density/language/scale interaction and geometry receipts when launches are authorized.

nextScopes.work: Apply section hierarchy, consistent fields, local search/builder, readable preset controls, bounded inspector scrolling and measured object rows. Resolve hard-coded styling at these call sites without changing values or preset inheritance.
nextScopes.exclude: No slicing, grouping-solver, preset serialization, object identity or undo changes. Plater integration points require a separate reviewed owner.
nextScopes.acceptance: Prepare process/object panels remain reachable at the actual minimum size and all language/scale tuples; every existing parameter and action remains available.

nextScopes.work: Map renderer-owned toolbar, legends, timeline, tooltips and selection affordances to the same hierarchy and state roles while preserving data colors and actual hit targets.
nextScopes.exclude: No geometry, toolpath, slider-value, camera, selection, simulation or Model Creator algorithm changes. No arbitrary canvas crossfade.
nextScopes.acceptance: Actual canvas states, tooltip bounds and temporal transitions need renderer-specific built evidence; shared native palette tests cannot stand in for it.

nextScopes.work: Unify native telemetry cards, printer rows, fan/camera controls, material mapping popups and print-option geometry. Show actual pending/offline states without layout jumps.
nextScopes.exclude: No DeviceCore, AMS identity/mapping logic, telemetry parsing, hardware command, camera lifecycle or embedded CSS changes. Preserve the independent AMS fixes.
nextScopes.acceptance: Native and embedded monitor boundaries need separate receipts; test unavailable/pending/confirmed states without asserting real hardware execution.

nextScopes.work: Apply native collection/detail, settings and stepped-flow composition to every registered section and nested dialog, with measured bilingual labels and reachable footer actions. Split additional writable scopes by exact file before dispatch.
nextScopes.exclude: No calibration algorithms, scheduling precedence, timezone semantics, authentication, network bridge, project serialization or shared-widget edits.
nextScopes.acceptance: Explicit nested-section inventory, unchanged option/callback mapping, and real minimum-size and keyboard proof; missing canonical features remain separate incomplete obligations.

nextScopes.work: Complete call-site geometry and hierarchy for readers, history, palettes, editors and anchored overlays. Enumerate every nested dialog and missing implementation before splitting exact owned paths into smaller work units.
nextScopes.exclude: No command registry, regex engine, restore semantics, export serializers, credential handling or destructive-confirmation behavior changes. Missing tool implementations are not supplied by a visual board.
nextScopes.acceptance: Per-dialog search/builder, focus return, actual accessible state and content bounds; confirmation still requires its existing independent controls.

verificationBoundary: All next scopes remain unassigned proposals. Source existence and shared colors never establish complete styling, functionality, localization, native compilation or rendered proof. Runtime/viewer/fixture/parity states and all existing 1,204 feature obligations remain unchanged.
